summary: Pinned consumers lack a current Idric lane
acceptance: IB ICU Hopf and the Unicode picker pass both their exact baseline and an exact reviewed current Idric revision

summary: Moving Idric refs are not receipt bound
acceptance: Every moving-ref job records the resolved compiler SHA and binds its result to that SHA

summary: Idric geometry regeneration is outside CI
acceptance: CI rebuilds the generated geometry with a full Idric pin and rejects drift

summary: Grease has no declared Idric compatibility seam
acceptance: A reviewed boundary either names a real Idric dependency and probe or explicitly keeps Grease independent

summary: Wegert-family apps do not consume the compiler backend path
acceptance: Wegert and analytic continuation name and test the exact intended Idric and GLSL backend tuple

summary: Shader backend self-tests only against upstream Idris 2
acceptance: The backend tests one exact current Idric revision and publishes a bound result

summary: ARM backend has no automated Idric compiler API lane
acceptance: CI tests the exact Idric Float32 and compiler API revision required by the ARM backend

summary: Recent Idris consumers have no Idric migration decision
acceptance: Each upstream-only consumer either gains an exact Idric lane or records why it remains upstream-only

summary: Planned compiler integrations have no executable tuple
acceptance: Each integration target names and runs an exact compiler and backend combination

summary: Catfood clones external backends without compatibility tests
acceptance: Catfood records exact backend revisions and runs their intended Idric compatibility probes
